sections.label: ARP insurance scheme protection
sections.summary: The Assisted Reproduction Programme insurance scheme protects against high neonatal bills for babies conceived via in-vitro fertilisation.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: The Assisted Reproduction Programme (ARP) insurance scheme provides protection against possible high costs in neonatal bills incurred by babies conceived via in-vitro fertilisation (IVF).

sections.label: ARP insurance purchase timing review
sections.summary: Couples must buy ARP insurance when enrolling for IVF; deferring purchase to later would shrink the risk pool and raise premiums.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: Couples are currently required to purchase ARP insurance at the point when they enroll for IVF.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: The Ministry of Health (MOH) is currently reviewing this policy.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: If the requirement to purchase insurance is deferred to a later stage, such as upon successful pregnancies from IVF, the risk pool will be smaller and the insurance premiums higher.

sections.label: ARP insurer and policy review
sections.summary: ARP insurance was awarded by open tender to Great Eastern in 2011, and MOH is reviewing conditions and criteria.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: The ARP insurance scheme was awarded via open tender to Great Eastern in 2011.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: The Ministry of Health (MOH) has decided that there is no need to have more than one provider currently because the pool is relatively small.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: With regard to the review of our ARP insurance policies, the conditions and criteria, we are looking at them and several issues.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: We will come to a decision in due course.
